title: The Pale Stag
subtitle: A kill by customName
description: `customName` counts only a mob carrying this name, which is how a quest reaches a named individual rather than a species. A wolf named The Pale Stag is a different hunt from any other wolf, and the task says so in one field.
Its line is drawn with `arrowPlace: both`, one head at each end — the placement for a line that is also a warning.
